pick.name: GitHub Projects
pick.what: Issues/PRs in table, board and timeline-roadmap views with custom fields and automation
pick.why: Lives next to the code; Claude Code drives it with gh, no issue cap, no extra vendor.
pick.free_limits: Free with GitHub; 50 fields per project

alts.name: Linear (free)
alts.what: Fast issue tracker with roadmaps and MCP
alts.why: Best UX and an official MCP; 250-issue cap on free.
alts.free_limits: Free: unlimited members, 250 issues, 2 teams, 10 MB uploads. Basic $10/user/mo

alts.name: Featurebase (free)
alts.why: Add when customers should vote on the roadmap.
alts.free_limits: Free: 1 seat, 1 feedback board, 1 roadmap, 500 survey shows/mo; Growth $29/seat/mo

candidates.name: Plane
candidates.verdict: AGPL, cloud free up to 12 users

decision: GitHub Projects has no item cap and sits where Claude Code already works. Switch to Linear when you hire and want its speed; add Featurebase when you need a customer-facing roadmap.
